mapper.select: select employee_id empId ,department_id deptId ,first_name firstName" ,last_name lastName ,date_format(hire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') hireDate ,salary salary ,email email from employees where year(hire_date) = #{year}

select employee_id empId , department_id deptId , first_name firstName , last_name lastName , date_format(hire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') hireDate ,salary salary ,email email from employees where department_id = #{deptId}
select d.department_id from departments d join employees e on d.Manager_id = e.Employee_id where lower(concat(e.first_name)) = #{managerName};

select e.employee_id empId, e.department_id deptId, e.first_name firstName, e.last_name lastName, date_format(e.hire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') hireDate, e.salary salary, e.email email from employees e join departments d on e.department_id = d.department_id join locations l on d.location_id = l.location_id where lower(l.city) = #{city};

select employee_id empId , department_id deptId , first_name firstName , last_name lastName , date_format(hire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') hireDate ,salary salary ,email email from employees where lower(first_name) = #{firstName.toLowerCase()}

select d.department_name deptName, round(avg(e.salary), -2) avg, max(e.salary) maxs, min(e.salary) mins from employees e join departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id group by d.department_id, d.department_name order by d.department_id;
